outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status evaluation is not discordant: both parallel and serial failed with 0/70. The concrete task-solving difference is delivery state, not pass/fail outcome. Parallel used a successful probe swarm but then placed all implementation, testing, and final delivery in one child that was cancelled, leaving an empty artifact. Serial kept the work local and left three helper modules in the artifact, but it also never produced test2.mjs or a complete converter.
parallel_contributors: The parallel parent delegated the whole implementation and verification package to one child after the probe swarm.
The implementation child was cancelled before returning a complete result, and final artifact validation found no files.
serial_contributors: The serial actor kept ownership local and wrote three helper modules before cancellation.
The serial artifact still lacked the required test2.mjs entry point.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts underestimated the size of cloning Python-Markdown extra behavior under the time budget.
Serial's local partial files were captured, while parallel's delegated partial writes were not present in the artifact.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no official outcome difference; one retained parallel adverse coordination episode explains the emptier parallel delivery state
